question: What would come in (5)
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3**' i.e. '**distortion**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage emphasizes that freedom without responsibility can lead to negative outcomes in society.
 
• The blank (5) refers to the consequence or misrepresentation of freedom when it lacks accountability.
 
• '**Distortion**' fits here as it denotes a twisted or misleading version of what true freedom means. (विकृति)
 
• Other options like 'rejection', 'misunderstanding', or 'creation' do not fully capture the nuanced consequence implied by the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**distortion**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rejection** (अस्वीकृति): Means refusal; does not convey the nuanced misrepresentation of freedom.
 
• **Misunderstanding** (गलतफहमी): Means incorrect perception; partially fits but is less precise than 'distortion'.
 
• **Creation** (निर्माण): Means bringing something into existence; irrelevant in this context.
